== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added from old swccgpc.com pages: the late-2002 Decktech partnership and the call for Young Jedi and Jedi Knights event volunteers ([https://web.archive.org/web/20040620161313/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/roadtoworlds03.htm Road to Worlds 2003]); the March 2003 Classic Format Subcommittee changes ([https://web.archive.org/web/20030824053912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/classicnews03312003.htm 31 March 2003]); Duane Bruun as Squadron Member ([https://web.archive.org/web/20031229115404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/may03archives.htm May 2003 updates]); the June 2004 advocate roles (New Advocates page, already cited); and the May 2006 call for volunteers ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220108/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=8 sid=8]).
=== Missing data ===
* The Road to Worlds 2003 page carries no date; it says only "As the New Year approaches" and looks back on 2002. The citation gives "undated, late 2002".
* Left out: the role addresses (Classic Format Subcommittee, Duane Bruun) and Scott Lingrell's personal address in the 2006 post.

* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=155300#p155300 CONFIRMED:  Worlds Date], Michael Carr (mc9457) (7 August 2006)
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=160692#p160692 CONFIRMED:  Worlds Date], NateA (24 August 2006)
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=201849#p201849 2007 Qualifier Event Decklists], Advocate (14 March 2007)
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=218508#p218508 2007 Qualifier Event Decklists], Advocate (18 July 2007)
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=268303#p268303 Star Wars: The Road to Europe 2008!  Full Schedule], Michael Erisman (mserisman) (18 February 2008)
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307954#p307954 Star Wars: The Road to Europe 2008! Full Schedule], Advocate (17 June 2008)
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308123#p308123 Question], Cedric (simone89) (18 June 2008)
* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317162#p317162 Canadian Nationals - info in first post], Advocate (22 July 2008)
* Added: June 2006 bullet: Wisconsin States bye/V-card ruling (Kolnik 15 June; Carr 22 June TD application; Carr's final decision 23 June)
* Added: August 2006 bullet: 2006 Worlds moved to Thursday–Saturday; NateA and the website calendar
* Added: 2007 bullet: first year of posting qualifier decklists (Event Decklists forum), design-team review, aim of 100% of decklists
* Added: February 2008 bullet: Road to Europe 2008 schedule and European Flight Leaders
* Added: June 2008 bullet: approval procedure for Open and Mini-Open qualifiers (Cedric)
* Added: July 2008 bullet extended: six-month ban of Patrick Dinelle by the tournament team; late approval of the 2008 Canadian Nationals
* Left out: The 26 July 2008 rule for the 2009 Match Play Championship (timed wins worth 2 points, differential = life-force difference): a tournament rule, not a change to the PC's structure; offered as a cross-group row for [[2009 Match Play Championship]].
* Left out: Forum protest against the June 2006 ruling and Carr's comparison with "Raltiir" (opinion).
* Left out: "Scott Lingrell said" (gap list): the July 2007 decklist post is by the shared Advocate account, not signed.
* Left out: Personal e-mail addresses in the European Flight Leader list.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Road to Europe 2008: the schedule gives the Germany regional as 11 May 2008 in Hannover; the Ralltiir Regionals thread (t19214, p=300942) says the date was changed to 10 May.
* The Flight Leader list is cut off after Germany in the forum text ("Johannes “Nico”"); any later countries are not in the captured text.
